evidence: Changes descriptor creation logic in src/script/descriptor.cpp and .h to construct multisig descriptors for wallet import flows
rationale: Adds CreateMultisigDescriptor() to safely construct and validate ranged multipath multisig descriptors without error-prone string interpolation. While it establishes key infrastructure intended to unblock the Multisig Wizard (#35645) and modernized multisig RPCs, it is currently an uncalled C++ helper pending integration into wallet setup flows.
